div.p: Immersive group experiences designed to reset your nervous system, deepen body awareness and reconnect you to yourself.

video.aria-label: Resting on the floor of a quiet, light room

div.p: 1:1 sessions are powerful — but retreats and workshops create something different. When a group of people commit to a shared experience together, the collective field amplifies the individual journey. There is permission to go deeper, let go more fully and be witnessed in the process.
HummingBeing retreats and workshops are carefully designed immersive experiences — combining TRE™, Somatic Healing, Breathwork, movement and reflection — in spaces that invite genuine transformation.
From half-day introductions to multi-day immersions — in Singapore, Japan and beyond.

article.p: Focused, accessible group sessions introducing somatic practices — TRE™, Breathwork or EFT — in a supportive group setting. Perfect for those curious about somatic work or wanting a deeper dive on a specific modality.

img.alt: Participants at a HummingBeing weekend retreat

article.p: Multi-day immersions in carefully chosen locations in Singapore and Japan. A combination of group somatic practice, individual integration time, nature connection and nourishing meals — designed to reset the nervous system at depth.

img.alt: Corporate wellness session at INSEAD with Simba Stenqvist

article.p: Bespoke somatic wellness sessions designed for teams — addressing stress, burnout, communication and resilience at the organisational level. Delivered in-house or off-site, half-day to full-day formats.
Facilitated group TRE™ practice — experiencing the body’s natural tremor mechanism together in community. A powerful introduction to TRE™ and an effective regular practice for existing practitioners.

Intimate group healing experiences combining Reiki, Breathwork, EFT and somatic movement. A safe container for deep rest, release and reconnection. Limited to small groups to ensure depth and personal attention.

img.alt: Professional somatic training for coaches and therapists

article.p: Workshops and training programmes for coaches, therapists and wellness practitioners wanting to deepen their embodied practice and integrate somatic approaches into their work with clients.

div.p: Immersive physiological and strategic resets for leaders ready to perform at their highest level.

article.p: An immersive sanctuary designed to prevent executive burnout and restore sustainable peak performance. By fusing advanced coaching, somatic and mindfulness techniques, this programme physically discharges accumulated stress and bypasses mental fatigue.

Generous daily self-reflection blocks provide the rare luxury of unstructured space to integrate deep breakthroughs and crystallise clear boundaries. You will return to work recalibrated — calm, deeply embodied, and leading with resilient authority.

A rapid down-regulation experience that shifts executives from survival mode into deep physiological recovery. It physically shakes off stored corporate stress while surfacing the subconscious cognitive saboteurs driving burnout.
You will return to work re-centred, equipped with immediate somatic tools to maintain clear boundaries and resilient, calm authority.

div.p: Each retreat is unique — but every one follows the same arc of arrival, release and integration.
We begin by slowing down — settling into the body, getting present in the space, and meeting the group with curiosity and openness. No performance, no agenda imposed from the outside.
Guided TRE™, Breathwork, movement or Somatic Healing sessions — supported by Isabelle throughout. The pace follows the group’s natural rhythm, not a clock.
Space to rest, journal, reflect or simply be. The body needs time to integrate what has been released — this is not downtime, it is an essential part of the healing arc.
Optional group sharing in a confidential, supportive container. A closing practice to anchor the experience and prepare you to carry it into daily life.

HummingBeing retreats are held in carefully selected venues — spaces that support rest, presence and deep healing rather than busy hotel conference rooms. Past locations have included intimate wellness studios, nature-surrounded resorts and traditional ryokan in Japan.
